Container.Name: Camofox-MCP-Standalone
Container.Overview: Runs Camofox Browser and its HTTP MCP adapter together. One port serves the browser REST API and the /mcp endpoint, each with its own bearer key. Optional noVNC uses a separate port. This image runs on x86-64 (AMD64).
Container.Requires: Set separate REST Access and MCP HTTP API keys before starting. Generate the MCP key with openssl rand -hex 32. Do not expose these ports publicly. Restrict them to trusted clients and use TLS for MCP whenever the endpoint is reachable beyond loopback. Use the default Data path for a fresh install. To migrate, stop the old Browser container and back up its appdata before explicitly selecting that path for Data. Never run both containers against the same directory.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Browser profiles, cookies, uploads, and traces. May contain login credentials; back up and protect this directory.

Config.Name: REST and MCP Port
Config.Description: One port serves REST and Streamable HTTP at exactly /mcp, without a trailing slash. Do not map the internal backend ports.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP API Key
Config.Description: Client bearer key for /mcp. Use 64 random lowercase hex characters, distinct from all Browser keys.

Config.Name: REST Access Key
Config.Description: Separate random bearer key for the Browser REST API. The bundled adapter uses it for its internal REST calls.

Config.Name: Cookie API Key
Config.Description: Optional separate key for direct REST cookie imports. The bundled MCP adapter does not receive it.

Config.Name: noVNC Web Port
Config.Description: Optional noVNC web desktop at /vnc.html. Omit the mapping if unused. Traffic is not encrypted by default; keep it on a trusted LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: Enable noVNC
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable shared human-and-LLM browser access through noVNC.

Config.Name: noVNC Password
Config.Description: Set a separate password of 8 random ASCII characters before enabling noVNC; classic VNC authentication ignores additional characters.

Config.Name: noVNC Bind Address
Config.Description: Allows the mapped noVNC port to reach the service inside the container. Do not publish native VNC port 5900.

Config.Name: Disable Crash Telemetry
Config.Description: Keep crash and hang reports local for this private deployment.
